name: Lou Is Mine
source:
Lou, a young impoverished woman, has been constantly scrambling to earn a living while simultaneously attending school. Amidst such a hectic daily routine, Lou began to neglect her evening meals. Unable to stand idly by and watch her friend suffer, her childhood friend, Myu-Myu, promised to make lunchboxes for her every day for a week... but things don't go quite as planned.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13753]Novelgame[/url]]
